map.滑雪坡度换算器：输入垂直落差与水平距离，同时得到坡度比值、百分比坡度与坡面角度，: Ski slope converter: enter vertical drop and horizontal distance to get the slope ratio, grade percentage and slope angle in one pass. Runs fully in your browser; no data is uploaded and no sign-up is required.
map.比值 = 1 : 水平距离 ÷ 垂直落差；百分比坡度 = 垂直落差 ÷ 水平距离: Ratio = 1 : horizontal distance ÷ vertical drop; grade percentage = vertical drop ÷ horizontal distance × 100%; slope angle = atan(vertical drop ÷ horizontal distance) × 180 ÷ π. Validation: when horizontal distance ≤ 0 or vertical drop < 0 the page shows a hint and outputs nothing; when vertical drop is 0 the ratio shows "—" and the angle is 0°.
map.三种表达描述同一个坡面：比值看「每升 1 个单位要走多远」，百分比看「每走 10: The three forms describe the same slope: the ratio tells how far you travel per unit of rise, the percentage tells how much you rise per 100 units travelled, and the angle is the slope's tilt from horizontal. Ski difficulty is usually expressed in degrees, roads and running in percent.
map.请填写垂直落差与水平距离后再计算: Please enter both vertical drop and horizontal distance.
map.水平距离需大于 0，垂直落差不能为负: Horizontal distance must be greater than 0, and vertical drop cannot be negative.
map.雪道图只标百分比或只标角度时，用落差与水平距离统一换算成三种表达。: When a trail map shows only a percentage or only an angle, use drop and horizontal distance to convert it into all three forms.
map.骑行、跑步路线把「爬升 / 距离」换算成坡度百分比，便于比较不同路段。: Convert climb over distance into a grade percentage for cycling and running routes so segments can be compared.
map.野外雪坡用角度判断陡度；>30° 的坡面需按雪崩风险规则另行评估。: Use the angle to judge steepness in the backcountry; slopes over 30° need a separate avalanche-risk assessment.
map.落差 10 m、水平距离 100 m：比值 = 1 : 10.00，百分比坡度: Drop 10 m over a horizontal distance of 100 m: ratio = 1 : 10.00, grade = 10.00%, slope angle = atan(0.1)×180/π ≈ 5.71°. Conversely, a 30° slope is tan30°×100 ≈ 57.74%, i.e. 57.74 m of rise over 100 m of horizontal travel.
map.百分比坡度和角度是什么关系？: How are grade percentage and angle related?
map.百分比坡度 = tan(角度)×100%。两者不是线性换算：10% 约 5.71: Grade percentage = tan(angle)×100%. The two are not linearly related: 10% is about 5.71°, 20% about 11.31°, and only 100% equals 45°.
map.为什么比值写成「1 : x」？: Why is the ratio written as "1 : x"?
map.表示每上升 1 个单位需要水平前进 x 个单位，与百分比、角度描述同一个坡面，只: It means x units of horizontal travel per unit of rise; it describes the same slope as the percentage and the angle, just in a different convention.
map.坡度 = 垂直升高 / 水平距离 x 100%: grade = vertical gain / horizontal distance x 100
map.结果保留两位小数；垂直落差与水平距离需使用同一长度单位（米 / 米）。: Results keep two decimals; vertical drop and horizontal distance must use the same length unit (m / m).
map.角度由 atan(落差 ÷ 水平距) 换算，百分比坡度 = tan(角度)×10: The angle comes from atan(drop ÷ distance); grade percentage = tan(angle)×100%.
map.只换算几何坡度，不含雪况、起伏与雪崩风险判断；水平距离 ≤ 0 或落差为负时不计: This converts geometric slope only; it does not cover snow conditions, terrain undulation or avalanche risk. Nothing is computed when horizontal distance ≤ 0 or drop is negative.
